done_when: forge.toml sets workers = "codex" with Codex models for build, fix and lite, matching the owner's setup elsewhere, and forge doctor passes

findings.body: The required end-to-end regression test is missing. The suite wired through package.json:86–88 runs unit and integration tests, but none invokes Forge to verify this worker/model selection or `forge doctor`. The existing Forge workflow invokes `forge hook pr-check` (.github/workflows/forge.yml:47), which does not supply that test. Add suite-wired coverage through Forge's real command entry point that verifies Codex selection for build, fix and lite and checks doctor success; reverting the worker selection to Claude must fail it.
findings.title: Not done: end-to-end coverage for Codex worker selection and forge doctor

why: This repo still builds with Claude workers, but the owner wants Codex workers for all implementation in every repo
